verdict.rationale: Stripe publishes official OpenAPI specifications for its API in the stripe/openapi GitHub repository. They come in JSON and YAML, with GA, preview and legacy variants, and they cover the Billing resources. The probe 404s at docs.stripe.com paths only show the spec isn't hosted there; they don't contradict the GitHub-hosted spec. Missing for 10: a Billing-scoped spec or spec discoverable from the docs domain, and independent hands-on corroboration of downloading and using the spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: This repository contains OpenAPI specifications for Stripe's API
